structured_output.summary: The diff follows spec steps 1-12 in order. Validation errors go through IteratorClose with the iterator record whose next method is undefined, as the spec says. GetIteratorDirect runs after validation. The closure keeps the buffer, drops the oldest element once the buffer is full, and yields full windows. At the end it yields one partial window only when undersized is allow-partial, the buffer is non-empty and shorter than windowSize. Return completions close the iterator after a full window's Yield and are discarded after the partial Yield, as the spec says. The gate shows 70 new passes, no regressions and no not-implemented results. Only the in-scope file changed.
